title: fix(cli): avoid session ID failures after gateway startup
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes intermittent `openclaw agent --session-id <id>` failures immediately after a local Gateway becomes ready, while its session store is still initializing. Found during AOT/JIT differential QA and reproduced on both runtimes.

The CLI previously read local session metadata before dispatch even though the Gateway owns it. Local and remote calls now let the Gateway resolve the ID, including abort targeting. Stored IDs resume their existing session; unseen IDs use the Gateway's existing create-or-resume resolver. Other RPC callers retain existing-only behavior and session authorization.

An optional `createSessionIfMissing` field carries CLI intent. The Gateway advertises this capability, and the CLI checks it before dispatch. Older Gateways must be updated and restarted before this CLI's `--session-id` can be used; unsupported servers receive no turn. No protocol version bump or data migration is required. A small identity-helper extraction keeps the existing CLI module within its line-growth limit without changing scopes.

CI also exposed test readiness problems. The mobile drawer test now waits for drawer focus before Escape. The owners-picker test waits for its opening animation and verifies search focus before Escape. The skill-refresh integration test loads its server and embedded-agent subjects during collection, reducing time spent inside its unchanged 90-second behavioral deadline. These retain the original assertions and change no production UI behavior.

Release-note context: Gateway-backed CLI session IDs no longer depend on local session-store initialization; preserve named-session creation and check Gateway support before dispatch.

## Evidence

- Original negative control on unmodified main `a6ee916f94a1`: local dispatch fails with `SessionMetadataUnavailableError` (`schema-missing`); remote dispatch passes. A separate negative control confirms the unseen-ID creation regression before the Gateway repair.
- Six focused files: 212 passed and one existing platform skip, 213.22s wall including worker compilation. Covers real schema-less SQLite dispatch, persisted ownership, creation, ordinary existing-only requests, cancellation, capability refusal, and hello advertisement. Local/remote regression passed again after main integration in 18.13s.
- Formatter, targeted lint, core production types, line-growth checks, protocol generation, and Swift/Kotlin contract checks passed. Full setup/build passed before the capability follow-up in 26m 5s; complete runtime builds subsequently passed on both the PR and clean main.
- Mobile drawer case passed in 80.92s wall. Owner-picker keyboard cases passed on Bun in 11.66s wall. The skill-refresh cold-cache replay passed in 80.65s wall, with its test body reduced from 72.76s to 25.07s. No assertions were removed and no timeout was increased.
- Historical broad local checks found an unused `renderMcpServerForm` export and an environment-variable count of 455 against a 454 budget. Both were reproduced on clean main and are outside this diff; the review record preserves those failures separately from exact-head CI.
- Independent Codex reviews of the product change and each test repair are clean at P0–P2.

Exact-head CI for `3949e918d466`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38589232105 (completed: one inherited Workboard locale failure and its aggregate gate; all other selected jobs, including security-fast, passed).

Earlier CI failures were investigated before repair. The previous Android Wear failure was an HTTP/2 Git checkout interruption before tests ran. The remaining current-head failure is the pre-existing Workboard French locale test: its captured main parent renders “Modifier le tableau” and “Couleur,” while the unchanged test searches for English labels. Clean main `833a4b8d48b6` reproduces the same “Edit board” timeout in 36.45s wall. The test, plugin implementation/catalog, and fixtures are unchanged between the CI main parent and tested merge. This is documented inherited-failure evidence; CI is not claimed green.

Main independently fixed the locale selectors in [efbe8513fc85](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/efbe8513fc85d8f49532a9153a8bd157f70dddf1) after this CI snapshot. The native inherited-failure admission retains the failed snapshot and its clean-main reproduction; the eventual merge includes that main repair.
